item.description: Update to fuse-overlayfs 1.17 to fix CVE-2026-52791: privilege escalation via SUID/SGID bit preservation on file truncation. item.description: A DNSSEC validating resolver that is under a random subdomain attack against a DNSSEC-signed zone can suffer from runaway memory usage.
